transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hey. Uh... mostly just having some issues at work, I guess. I manage construction jobs, and... well, I'll sit down for a plan review or a safety briefing, really trying to pay attention. But a couple minutes in, my head is just... somewhere else. Thinking about three other problems on the site. Then I end up missing things. Things I know I should've caught.
When did you first start having these kinds of difficulties with your attention and focus?

Uh... a long time ago, I guess. Probably back in elementary school. 

I just remember teachers were always telling my parents I couldn't stay in my seat... or I'd talk out of turn. Stuff like that. Always losing my homework. They said I'd just... rush through the directions before I really understood what I was supposed to be doing. So... yeah. It's been a while.
Do you currently feel a constant sense of restlessness or find it difficult to sit still?
Uh... I don't know. I haven't really noticed. I'm on my feet a lot at the site anyway, so... I don't really have to sit still that much. So, I guess... not really.
Do you often find yourself interrupting other people before they have finished speaking?

Yeah... sometimes. I guess if someone's asking me something, I... I just sort of assume I know where they're going with it. So I'll just answer before they finish. But... then I realize I missed the actual point they were trying to make, 'cause they hadn't gotten to it yet. So... yeah, I do that.
Do you often feel like you are 'on the go,' acting as if you're driven by a motor?
Uh... I don't really know what you mean by that. I mean, I'm busy. Work keeps me moving, so... I just do what needs to be done. I don't really think about it like a motor or anything.
Do you often find yourself tapping your hands or feet, or fidgeting with things when you have to stay seated?
I don't know... maybe a little? I mean, I guess I might tap my foot sometimes or mess with a pen if I'm stuck in a meeting. But... I don't really pay attention to it. It's just... normal, I think.
Do you often have a hard time waiting your turn, like when you're waiting in line or waiting for your turn in group situations?

Yeah, I guess. Waiting is... it's tough. Like, if I'm stuck on a call, or down at the permit office... or even just a regular line. It just drives me nuts. I end up checking my watch a lot, shifting around... just trying not to, you know, push past people to get it over with. So... yeah, I don't like waiting.
Do you often find yourself talking excessively or having trouble stopping once you start talking?

I mean... I guess so. Sometimes. If there's an issue on the site, like a problem with a pour or something... I just start explaining it. And... I guess I kind of keep going. Like, going over it from every angle. Even when I can see the guys are just... done. They want to move on, but I just... keep talking about it. So, yeah. Maybe.
Do you often find yourself butting into other people's conversations or taking over what they are doing without being invited?

I suppose... yeah. Sometimes. Like on the site... if I see a couple of subcontractors talking, or maybe someone's working through some paperwork, I'll just kind of walk up and jump right in with my own point. Before they even ask. I know it... rubs people the wrong way sometimes. But, yeah. I guess I do that.
